avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Vitamin E has antiplatelet and anticoagulant properties that may potentiate bleeding risk in patients receiving romiplostim for thrombocytopenia management
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose supplementation; monitor platelet counts closely if patient insists on use

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic extract (concentrated supplements)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Garlic possesses antiplatelet aggregation properties that may increase bleeding risk and counteract the therapeutic benefit of romiplostim
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concentrated garlic supplements; culinary amounts are acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Ginger supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet effects; unlikely to significantly interact but may theoretically enhance bleeding risk at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use moderate amounts; counsel patient on bleeding precautions

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild platelet-modulating effects; clinical significance unclear with romiplostim
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for changes in platelet response; no strict contraindication required

avoid_foods.name: Excessive alcohol
avoid_foods.mechanism: Alcohol impairs bone marrow function and platelet production, directly opposing romiplostim's therapeutic mechanism and increasing bleeding and thrombosis risk
avoid_foods.action: Strongly counsel against alcohol consumption; recommend abstinence or minimal intake

caution_foods.name: Cranberry juice (large quantities)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains compounds with mild antiplatelet properties; unlikely to clinically interact but high consumption should be moderated
caution_foods.action: Counsel moderate consumption; monitor platelet counts if patient consumes large quantities

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May affect subcutaneous injection absorption kinetics minimally; no direct pharmacodynamic interaction
caution_foods.action: No restriction necessary; ensure consistent injection technique independent of meals

monitoring_notes: Romiplostim is a protein therapeutic with minimal drug-drug interactions via CYP450 metabolism; primary concern is additive antiplatelet/anticoagulant effects from supplements and alcohol that increase bleeding risk. Monitor platelet counts regularly and counsel patients to report bleeding symptoms, particularly when adding new supplements or increasing alcohol consumption.
